en: A black-and-white, vintage postcard depicting a panoramic view of a small town surrounded by hills. The landscape includes a prominent church with a steeple to the left, several clustered houses, and larger buildings, all set against a backdrop of wooded hills. The words 'Gruss aus Völkermarkt' are printed in decorative script on the lower left, and there is handwritten text along the bottom. The publisher's imprint 'Verlag v. Franz Huth in Völkermarkt' is printed on the lower right.
